entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: Planet closest to the supervoid Sothera in the Edge, colonized by the Monoists; the Kav called it Anuki.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: Supervoid in the Edge near Susur Secundi.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Order that colonized Susur Secundi, treating its labyrinths as holy sites of the Immortal Faller.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: People who first explored the planet as Anuki and did not contest the Monoist claim.

entities.name: Immortal Faller
entities.description: Being whose designs the Monoists see in the planet's underground structures.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: Opened the Sothera system to the rest of the Edge.

entities.name: Monastery Singul
entities.description: Monastery under construction in orbit above the planet.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: Spacecraft that fired upon Monastery Singul.

entities.name: Lip of Susur
entities.description: Site of the Monoist order's capital monastery.

events.summary: The Kav explored Anuki centuries ago but found it not worth exploiting.
events.quote: they found it thick with common minerals and not worth exploiting

events.summary: After Pinnacle opened Sothera, the Monoists came to Anuki, were elated at its labyrinths and claimed it; the Kav did not contest.
events.quote: The Kav did not contest their claim.

events.summary: The Monoists rename Anuki Susur Secundi and make it their main staging ground in the Sothera system.
events.quote: the main staging ground for Monoists in the Sothera system

events.summary: Dawnsire fires on Monastery Singul after a Monoist strike on the spacecraft.
events.quote: Was fired upon by Dawnsire after a Monoist strike on the spacecraft

relations.quote: It is colonized by the Monoists
the closest planet to the supervoid Sothera in the Edge
